name: console

sections.heading: Origin and explicit import
sections.text: Implicit origin: PRELUDE. Original module: std.console. Explicit alternative: import "std.console" { console; }.explicit; --no-prelude removes implicit visibility. Import every referenced prelude name explicitly; imports grant no capability.

sections.heading: Behavior, methods and protocols
sections.text: The retained document keeps typed nodes and payload bytes. Multiple publications retain lexical order. Int, Bool and Text have distinct node kinds. print is rejected.

sections.heading: Ownership and effects
sections.text: Publication is an explicit output effect. The retained document is observed locally by a binary trace oracle; this is not a claim of a live desktop display.

sections.heading: Errors and limits
sections.text: Wrong receiver/option types reject. Bounded document capacity and failure atomicity remain enforced; importing console grants no additional authority.

summary: Publish a typed value through the canonical Console surface.
title: std.prelude.console
